title: We Tested 9 Free AI Website Builders: The Best One in 2026
summary: We tested the free tier of nine AI website builders, not just the marketing page, to see what you actually get for $0. Blink came out on top for the free tier that's worth using.
body_markdown: Blink. Its free plan includes the full product, a real database, real authentication, and the same AI agent paid users get, live on a preview URL on a Blink subdomain with no ads and no card required. Production hosting and a custom domain of your own start at $25/mo on Starter. Most other free plans that publish live hand you ads, like Wix does, or a thinner product missing the features that made you want AI in the first place.
